items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I become house drummer for Billy Berg, you dig?

ctx.x: I think his father played bass.

Yeah. Anyway we come back and we have a rehearsal at the Club Alabam and Jimmy Mundy brings in some new charts, right. Man, I read those things like they was going out -- a lot of the cats in the band were scuffling and everything. Man, I just -- things like Queer Street, you know, all those -- I played all those charts, man. But anyway it was cool. I stayed on the band a couple of months and Jo came back and I was cool. In the meantime, I’m working around LA now gigging, you know, just playing -- I become house…
Who else was in the band?
